purpose.zh: 拉伸前腿髋外侧和臀部
purpose.en: Stretch the outer hip and glute of the front leg.

text.zh: 背部拉长，从髋部向前腿小腿上方前倾
text.en: Keep your back long and hinge forward over your front shin

text.zh: 前腿和侧腿都屈膝90度，胸口正对前腿
text.en: Bend both knees to 90 degrees and square your chest over the front shin.

text.zh: 臀部有拉伸感就停住，慢慢呼吸
text.en: Stop where you feel the glute stretch and breathe slowly.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to go deeper.

commonErrors.zh: 臀部离开地面歪向一侧
commonErrors.en: Letting the hips tip off the floor.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减小前倾幅度或垫高臀部，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Lean less or sit on a cushion if your knees hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
